traditional: The wound and the exile are one story told twice: what was hurt and what was banished are often the same want.

modern.blend: The healing stalls until the forbidden want is admitted; then both move.
modern.harmonious: The reclaimed desire turns out to be medicine; shame dissolves when the stories are told together.
modern.hard: Treating the want and the wound as separate cases keeps both open.
modern.business: The blocked ambition and the old injury share a root; address them as one case.

cyclicNote: Node entries read to the axis: contact with one node is always contact with both; never render separate NN and SN cards for one event.
